title: Astro — Content-Focused Framework
description: Build fast content sites with Astro — islands architecture, content collections, and zero JS by default.

entries.label: Create Project
entries.command: npm create astro@latest my-site -- --template basics --typescript strict
entries.description: Scaffold a new Astro project with TypeScript in strict mode

entries.label: Add Integration
entries.description: Add React and Tailwind integrations automatically — modifies config and installs deps

entries.label: Astro Component
entries.description: Astro components have a frontmatter fence (---) for server-side JS and scoped styles

entries.label: Island (Client Directive)
entries.description: Hydrate interactive components only when needed: load, visible, idle, media, only

entries.label: Content Collection
entries.description: Define typed content collections with Zod schema validation

entries.label: Query Collection
entries.description: Fetch and sort content collection entries in page frontmatter

entries.label: Dynamic Routes
entries.description: Generate static pages for each content entry at build time

entries.label: Build & Deploy
entries.command:
npm run build
# Output in dist/ — deploy to any static host
# Netlify, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages
entries.description: Astro builds to static HTML by default — deploy anywhere
